subtitle: Touch the Sacred Sanskrit Sutras
promotional_text: Experience authentic Sanskrit chanting, word-by-word padaccheda, continuous Tanpura drone, and daily sacred sadhana offline.
short_description: Offline-first sacred Sanskrit sanctuary: Bhagavad Gita, Yoga Sutras, chanting & daily sadhana.
full_description:
Touch the sacred essence of ancient Sanskrit wisdom. SutraSparsh is an offline-first contemplation sanctuary crafted for spiritual seekers, yogis, and scholars.

Key Highlights:
• Complete Scripture Corpus: All 18 chapters of the Bhagavad Gita, Patanjali's 196 Yoga Sutras, and classical Vedic Upanishads.
• Authentic Study: Original Devanagari script, IAST transliteration, word-by-word padaccheda breakdown, and dual English & Hindi commentaries.
• Acoustic Atmosphere: Tap-to-chant recitation accompanied by an acoustic, microtonal Tanpura drone generator (136.1Hz Om / 432Hz natural frequency).
• Daily Sādhana Tracking: Brahma Muhurta dawn reminders, consecutive day streak tracker, radial daily study goal meter, and a private contemplative journal.
• Four Temple Themes: Hand-tuned Sandstone, Amethyst Nocturnal, Parchment Daylight, and Festival Deepam palettes.
• Data Sovereignty: 100% offline functionality with seamless JSON export and optional encrypted cloud sync.

Om Shanti Shanti Shanti.
